change.title: Migrate the compiled profile-switch writer to the V2 runtime journal
change.summary: Migrates the compiled, test-only profile-switch transaction writer from the V1 string stage to a typed V2 profile_switch/start_formal_gateway record without changing publication, Gateway start, rollback, reconciliation handoff, or finalization timing. The typed record carries prior binding and public Gateway identity, remains not_exposed with no runtime fingerprint or snapshot ticket, and rollback, finalization, cold handoff, and healthy-reopen commit compare the complete caller-published typed record. Same-process Science reconciliation may replace it with the first one-click V2 checkpoint only when the complete original profile-switch transaction matches; normal one-click and restart paths remain fail-closed. The product-reachable profile selection command remains intent-only, and interrupted Gateway recovery remains a later writer slice.

basis: the profile-switch source/unit identity freezes typed V2 schema, operation, phase, exposure, compensation, Gateway outcome, previous public identities, complete-record retarget protection, and secret-free serialization

the existing one-click journal identity covers complete-record same-process profile-switch handoff to a fresh one-click transaction and rejects transaction-id or same-id previous-Gateway drift from the caller-published original
the initial reconcile resolver and first checkpoint both reject disappeared, V1-regressed, or field-retargeted handoff journals while ordinary V1/empty one-click remains compatible and refuses V2

the healthy-reopen binding commit performs a second complete-record CAS, preserves bytes after same-id compensation drift between read and commit, and clears the journal only after the exact expected record is restored
focused profile-switch, V1/V2 schema, one-click handoff, isolated snapshot rollback, quality metadata, impact-pr, inventory, document governance, boundary, format, and diff checks passed
